name: Social Pin & Media Showcase
author: Maidul

sections.description:
This plugin shows Pinterest’s Save button on your images when a visitor moves the mouse over them. A click opens Pinterest so the visitor can save the image to a board (a Pinterest login is needed).

Pinterest’s own script draws the button. The plugin loads that script on your site and has a settings page under Settings > Social Pin, where you can choose a large or round button.

Not affiliated with or endorsed by Pinterest.

Features

  • Save button on image hover
  • Settings page
  • Translatable

External services

This plugin loads Pinterest’s script from https://assets.pinterest.com/js/pinit.js on the front-end pages of your site, for each visitor. The script draws the Save button. When it loads, the visitor’s browser connects to Pinterest, which receives standard request data such as the visitor’s IP address and may set or read its own cookies, as described in Pinterest’s policies. Pinterest terms of service: https://policy.pinterest.com/en/terms-of-service. Pinterest privacy policy: https://policy.pinterest.com/en/privacy-policy.

This plugin is not affiliated with or endorsed by Pinterest.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the dynamic-pin-it-button-on-image-hover folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Optional: open Settings > Social Pin to change the button style.
sections.faq:
Does it work without Elementor?

Yes. It needs no other plugin.

Which images get the button?

Images on your pages that Pinterest’s script accepts. Pinterest decides the minimum size.

Does it load anything from Pinterest?

Yes. See “External services”.

Can I hide it on some pages?

Not yet.

Is this the official Pinterest plugin?

No. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Pinterest.
